title: a completer error message at 40 columns: zsh interleaves it with the redrawn line, zshrs does not

observed.fingerprint_label: cell/rowtop/col0 | ref/_cachls /usr/**/z | test/_cache_invalid:#: command not found: zp
observed.notes: Both shells hit the same missing cache-policy function (zpwrMonthlyCachingPolicy is not defined under `zsh -f`). zsh's diagnostic is overwritten in place by the redrawn command line, so each 40-column row shows a fragment of the message followed by 'ls /usr/**/z'; zshrs prints the message intact and then drops the `-<<...>>-` format line zsh still shows. Geometry is load-bearing: 24x40.

confirmed.note: all three harness files had uncommitted edits when this was confirmed (three agents were editing them concurrently); the sha256 prefixes above pin the exact bytes used.
